messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Stakeholder Strategy | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Mendoza,

Given AMCDE’s work supporting major Saudi energy and industrial projects, I am introducing a senior profile focused on the institutional and stakeholder layer around complex operations. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications. I also support governance around industrial renewable energy and carbon-data traceability.

I am seeking Director, Senior Director, Head or VP-track Saudi opportunities across ESG, sustainability, external affairs, government relations, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and country leadership. My experience combines a mining operating environment with extensive public-sector and cross-functional engagement.

I am internationally mobile, available after a 30-day notice period and require employer-supported work authorization. My three-page executive CV is attached.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth “Randy” Ramsaroop
